full_name: Jennifer Quick | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Jennifer Quick is PhD candidate in the Department of History of Art and Architecture at Harvard University. She focuses on the history of photography and American art and also maintains an active interest in contemporary art and theory.
